name: The chocolate I made for you
source:
It's been more than two months since you and Dan lived together.

Recently, he's been acting mysteriously, sneaking to the kitchen when you least expect it.

But... the cat can't seem to keep that secret for too long.

[From [url=https://plushp.itch.io/the-chocolate-i-made-for-you-warmth-2-valentine]itch.io[/url]]
